household_message.text: Charge the car before I head out, and the dishwasher by 6pm.

message_to_household: The car cannot be fully charged to 80 % by 07:30 today due to limited time and charger capacity. It will charge as much as possible (about 45 %) by then. The dishwasher will run from 14:30 to 15:30 today using solar power, saving on grid electricity.

questions.text: Should I charge the car to about 45 % by 07:30 today, or would you prefer to adjust the target or time for charging?
Is the dishwasher scheduled to run from 14:30 to 15:30 today acceptable?

notes:
Read back (message sent Tue 07:00):
- car 80 % by Tue 07:30 (morning, in 0.5 h)
- dishwasher done by Tue 18:00 (evening, in 11.0 h)
warnings: the car cannot get the full 16.0 kWh by 05-24 07:30; the charger adds at most 1.9 kWh in that time, so the car will be at about 45 %. It charges at full power until then.
